text:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7402 but holding until architecture review. RFC is linked here: https://go.redwood/rfcs/112 (smart routing + prefix KV behavior).
Sam (platform): Thanks — can you drop a short summary of what actually changes so reviewers don't have to dig the whole RFC?
Maya R: TL;DR: 1) change fallback ordering to prefer cheaper model variants by default; 2) add a prefix-KV size cap (config: max_prefix_kv_bytes = 67_108_864); 3) introduce per-route routing weight to bias for latency vs cost. Also a small autoscaler tweak to keep steady qps during canary.
Ben A (arch): Changing fallback order worries me re: tail latency. Any perf numbers and a clear rollback plan?
Maya R: Ran a quick bench on Dedicated: 99p up ~8% for long seqs when cache miss rate spikes. PR includes perf table and a canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h + automatic rollback if 95p > SLO.
Chris - infra: FYI the PR touches autoscale window and margin defaults — need to ensure our cluster metrics retention covers the shorter window.
Sam (platform): @Ben A @Chris - can you give arch/infra ack by EOD? We won't merge without signoff.
Ben A (arch): I'll review and leave comments by 4pm PT — main ask: explicit safety toggle to restore old fallback ordering and a documented roll-forward/rollback procedure.
Chris - infra: I'll sanity-check the autoscaler delta. Might require a follow-up patch to the metrics exporter.
Maya R: Added a checklist in the PR: 1) arch LGTM, 2) infra LGTM, 3) perf numbers in the PR, 4) rollout plan link. Also pasted the canary config:
```yaml
canary: 
  percent: 5
  duration: 24h
  rollback_on: 
    - metric: p95_latency
      threshold: >300ms
```
Sam (platform): Nice, thanks. If we get both OKs we'll target merge tomorrow morning (low-traffic window).
Ben A (arch): Left a few inline comments. Biggest ask: add unit+integration tests that simulate cache-miss storm and verify fallback toggle works.
Maya R: Will add tests and push fixes today.
Chris - infra: One more nit — autoscaler window shortened from 60s -> 30s in this change; ensure retention/aggregation aligns with dashboard queries.
Maya R: Noted, I'll update the exporter config and add a note in the RFC's ops checklist.
deploy-bot: PR 7402 status: draft -> ready for review.
Maya R: Updated PR with perf table and canary script snippet. Ping me for any quick sync, otherwise prefer async. :thumbsup:
Sam (platform): Great — thanks everyone, ping here after your reviews and we'll coordinate merge order.
Maya R: Thanks all — will push the follow-ups shortly.
